data.scope: Official department or graduate-school pages only; Fall 2027 CS-related PhD admissions

programs.cycle: Fall 2027 (official page currently has a cycle-label inconsistency)
programs.gre: Not required/used; MIT EECS says it does not use GRE scores in admission (except the separate LGO program)
programs.sop_length_limit: No length limit stated on the official EECS admissions pages fetched; two essays are requested, including Research Activities and Goals and Academic and Intellectual Journey
programs.notes: The admissions page gives the December 1, 2026 deadline but labels the entry as September 2026, apparently inconsistent with the Fall 2027 cycle. Verify in the application portal.

programs.sop_length_limit: No more than 8,000 characters including spaces; also described as no more than two single-spaced pages

programs.program: Computer Science PhD, Computer Science Department
programs.application_deadline: Early: November 18, 2026 at 3:00 p.m. EST; final: December 9, 2026 at 3:00 p.m. EST
programs.application_fee: $80 per program by the early deadline; $100 per program after it
programs.gre: Optional; at-home GRE is not accepted, and omitting GRE scores does not disadvantage an application

programs.program: EECS PhD / Graduate Research Degree Programs
programs.application_fee: $135 for U.S. citizens and current permanent residents; $155 for other applicants, plus 4.22% payment-processing fee
programs.gre: Not accepted; EECS no longer requires or accepts GRE scores
programs.sop_length_limit: No word- or page-limit stated on the official EECS admissions page

programs.program: Paul G. Allen School CS&E PhD
programs.cycle: Latest official recurring-cycle information; Fall 2027 not explicitly labeled
programs.application_deadline: December 15 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific Time, or the next business day if December 15 falls on a weekend
programs.gre: Not accepted; scores are not required and will not be reviewed or considered
programs.notes: The Allen School says applications are accepted once yearly for an autumn start. The fetched official pages do not state a fixed number of recommendation letters or an SOP length limit, and do not explicitly label the deadline Fall 2027.

programs.program: Siebel School of Computing and Data Science PhD in Computer Science
programs.cycle: Latest official recurring-cycle information; Fall 2027 not explicitly labeled
programs.application_deadline: December 1, 11:59 p.m. U.S. Central Time (Fall only)
programs.notes: The official deadline page did not explicitly label the posted December 1 date as Fall 2027.

programs.cycle: Latest official information; Fall 2027 not explicitly published
programs.application_deadline: December 15 (year not specified on the department page)
programs.notes: The department page does not specify a Fall 2027 year or an SOP length limit.

programs.program: Department of Computer Science Doctoral Study Programme
programs.cycle: Ongoing/rolling admissions; no dated Fall 2027 cycle
programs.application_deadline: No deadline; applications are possible at any time
programs.sop_length_limit: No length limit stated; statement of objective required in English

message: Collected official-page admissions data for all eight programs. Where an official page did not explicitly publish a Fall 2027 label or a requested field, that is marked rather than inferred; verify cycle-specific details in the linked application portals before submitting.

suggestions.label: Compare deadlines
suggestions.prompt: Which of these programs has the earliest Fall 2027 deadline?

suggestions.label: GRE policy summary
suggestions.prompt: Which programs accept optional GRE scores, and which do not accept or consider them?
